P.name: Way of the Wanderer
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Intent:}} '''Yasuo's''' {{as|{{sti|'''total''' critical strike chance}}}} is doubled from all other sources. Additionally,{{ft|every {{as|1% critical strike chance}} in excess of {{as|100%|critical strike chance}} is converted into {{sti|{{as|{{fd|0.5}} '''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.|every {{as|50% critical strike chance}} in excess of {{as|100%|critical strike chance}} is converted into {{sti|{{as|25 '''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.}}
P.description2: '''Yasuo's''' {{tip|critically strike|critical strikes}} deal only{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Yasuo|crit_base}}|100|mod={{ccd|Yasuo|crit_mod}}}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}}.|{{fd|{{#expr:{{ccd|Yasuo|crit_mod}}*100}}}}% of the {{sti|{{as|critical damage}}}} champions usually have.}}
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Resolve:}} '''Yasuo''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of {{tip|Flow}} for every {{pp|59 to 46 for 3|1 to 13}} units he travels by any means. At{{ft|100 stacks|{{pp|59*100 to 46*100 for 3|1 to 13}} units traveled}}and upon taking damage from an enemy {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster}}, '''Yasuo''' consumes all {{tip|Flow}} to grant himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|125+((600-125)/17*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))) for 20}} that lasts for 1 second.

Q.name: Steel Tempest
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yasuo''' thrusts his sword in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects to the first enemy hit. ''Steel Tempest's'' damage based on its {{as|AD ratio}} can {{tip|critically strike}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}} {{as|(+ 105% AD)}}|Critical Strike Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}} {{as|(+ {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Yasuo|crit_base}}*1.05|105|mod={{ccd|Yasuo|crit_mod}}}}|critical damage}} AD)|ad}}}}
Q.description2: {{sbc|Steel Wind Rising:}} If this hits at least one enemy, '''Yasuo''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Gathering Storm'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 2 times and refreshing on subsequent hits. At 2 stacks, the next ''Steel Tempest'' cast consumes them all to become empowered with a new effect.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Gathering Storm Bonus:}} '''Yasuo''' unleashes a whirlwind in the target direction that applies and triggers the same effects and additionally {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} enemies hit for {{fd|0.9}} seconds.
Q.description4: ''Steel Tempest's'' thrust will fail to hit targets after the cast time if '''Yasuo''' was affected by {{tip|disarming crowd control}} during it, but the {{sti|cooldown}} of the ability is reset to {{fd|0.1}} seconds.
Q.description5: If ''Steel Tempest'' is cast during ''{{ai|Sweeping Blade|Yasuo}}'', the cast is modified to cause '''Yasuo''' to slash around himself at the end of the dash, applying and triggering the same effects against nearby enemies. This slash can be empowered by ''Gathering Storm's'' bonus, causing it to additionally apply the {{tip|airborne|knock up}} to enemies hit. ''Steel Tempest's'' cast time is not incurred when it is cast this way, but '''Yasuo''' will become {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks for {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the dash ends.
Q.static: {{as|{{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|4 to 1.48 for 8;4/3|key1=%|0 to 105;1000/9|formula=4*(1-(0.01 per 1.67% '''bonus''' attack speed)). ''This is capped at 67% reduction at 111.1% '''bonus''' attack speed.''}}|attack speed}}

W.name: Wind Wall
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yasuo''' raises a wall of wind in the target direction for 4 seconds that destroys all hostile non-{{tip|turret}} {{tip|projectile|projectiles}} that collide with it and grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings.
W.description2: The wall travels in the targeted direction over the first {{tt|{{fd|0.6}} seconds|Estimated}}, then drifts forward another 50 units over the remaining duration.

E.name: Sweeping Blade
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yasuo''' {{tip|dashes}} a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy and becomes {{tip|ghosted}} for 2 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts. Upon impact, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to the target and generates a stack of ''Ride the Wind'' for 5 seconds, which refreshes on subsequent hits and stacks up to 4 times.
E.description2: {{sbc|Ride the Wind:}} ''Sweeping Blade's'' damage is increased by 25% per stack, up to {{ap|25*4}}% at maximum stacks.
E.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Damage per Stack|{{ap|70*0.25 to 130*0.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*0.25}}% AP)}}|Maximum Bonus Damage|{{ap|70 to 130}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}|Total Combined Damage|{{ap|70*2 to 130*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*2}}% AP)}}}}
E.description3: ''Sweeping Blade'' can be cast on the same target only once every few seconds.
E.description4: '''''Yasuo''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.''
E.description5: ''{{ai|Last Breath|Yasuo}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Last Breath
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yasuo''' {{tip|blinks}} to the {{tt|opposite side|Relative to Yasuo's cast location}} of a {{tip|sight|visible}} {{tip|airborne}} enemy champion {{tt|nearest to the cursor|searches in a 1100 radius}}, instantly generating maximum {{tip|Flow}} while resetting ''{{ai|Steel Tempest|Yasuo|Gathering Storm}}'' stacks.
R.description2: Upon arrival, he {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} all nearby {{tip|airborne}} enemy champions for 1 second, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them, becoming {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} himself, and slashing them with his sword over the duration to deal {{as|physical damage}} thereafter. Surrounding enemy champions that become {{tip|airborne}} during this time will also be affected by ''Last Breath'' through the remaining duration.
R.description3: For the next 15 seconds, the damage dealt by '''Yasuo's''' {{tip|critical strikes}} ignores {{sti|lethality|{{as|60% of the target's '''bonus''' armor}}}}.
R.description4: ''A nearby {{tip|airborne}} enemy champion is required to cast this ability. If '''Yasuo''' would blink inside the {{sti|attack range}} of an enemy {{tip|turret}} (including the {{tip|Nexus Obelisk}}), Last Breath will instead attempt to position him outside of it.''
